aria-label.zh-CN: 手柄的可访问名称；range 模式下两个手柄在其后分别追加语言包中的起点、终点。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the handle. In range mode, the locale's start and end texts are appended for the two handles.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 引用标签元素的 id，作为手柄的可访问名称；range 模式下每个手柄再加上起点或终点。
aria-labelledby.en-US: The id of the labelling element, used as the handle's accessible name. In range mode each handle adds its start or end text.

aria-valuetext.zh-CN: 为当前值提供用户友好的名称。
aria-valuetext.en-US: A user-friendly name for the current value.

getAriaValueText.zh-CN: 为当前值提供用户友好的名称，参数为滑块的值与滑块的顺序。
getAriaValueText.en-US: Provides a user-friendly name for the current value, called with the handle's value and its index.

handleDot.zh-CN: 滑块上的圆点，单个滑块传一个对象，range 时按手柄传数组。
handleDot.en-US: Dot on the handle: one object for a single handle, an array with one per handle for a range.

id.zh-CN: 落在第一个手柄的 input 上，用于 label for 关联，点击 label 会聚焦该手柄。
id.en-US: Applied to the first handle's input, so a label for focuses that handle.

included.zh-CN: marks 不为空对象时有效，true 表示刻度为包含关系，false 表示并列。
included.en-US: Takes effect when marks is not empty. true makes the marks nested, false makes them independent.

mark.zh-CN: 自定义刻度标签的 snippet，也用于 tooltipOnMark 的提示；参数为 `{ value, label }`，即刻度的 value 与 label。
mark.en-US: Snippet for custom mark labels, also used for the tooltipOnMark tooltip. Its parameter is `{ value, label }`, the mark's value and label.

marks.zh-CN: 刻度，key 为 number 且取值在闭区间 [min, max] 内，值为字符串或数字；节点内容使用 mark snippet。
marks.en-US: Marks. Keys are numbers in the closed range [min, max], values are strings or numbers; use the mark snippet for node content.

onAfterChange.zh-CN: 值变化完成后的回调，参数为当前取值。绑定或单向传值时，每次值变化除 onChange 外也触发；不传 `value` 时拖动期间只触发 onChange，松开后触发一次。
onAfterChange.en-US: Called after a change is complete, with the current value. With a bound or one-way `value` it is called on every change in addition to onChange; without `value`, only onChange is called while dragging and this is called once on release.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个 Slider 时的回调，在两个手柄之间切换不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the whole Slider; moving between the two handles does not call it.

onChange.zh-CN: 值变化时的回调，参数为当前取值。
onChange.en-US: Called when the value changes, with the current value.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入 Slider 时的回调，是外层的 focusin，在手柄之间切换每次都触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the Slider. It is the wrapper's focusin, so it is called each time focus moves between handles.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 手柄 input 上的按键回调，先于 Slider 自己的处理；调用 `preventDefault()` 可阻止取值键移动手柄。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called for keys on the handle inputs, before the Slider's own handling; `preventDefault()` keeps a value key from moving the handle.

onMouseUp.zh-CN: 拖动滑块的指针（鼠标、触摸、触控笔）松开或被取消时，以及取值键松开时的回调。
onMouseUp.en-US: Called when the pointer (mouse, touch, pen) dragging a handle is released or cancelled, and when a value key is released.

railStyle.zh-CN: 滑块轨道的样式，只接受字符串。
railStyle.en-US: Style of the slider rail. Accepts a string only.

range.zh-CN: 是否支持两端同时可滑动。
range.en-US: Whether both ends can be dragged.

showArrow.en-US: Whether the tooltip has an arrow.

showBoundary.zh-CN: 是否在悬停时展示最大值与最小值。
showBoundary.en-US: Whether to show the maximum and minimum on hover.

showMarkLabel.en-US: Whether to show the mark labels.

step.zh-CN: 步长，从 min 起计算。

tip.zh-CN: 自定义手柄提示内容的 snippet；参数为 `{ value, handle }`，value 为 tipFormatter 的结果，handle 为 min 或 max。
tip.en-US: Snippet for custom handle tooltip content. Its parameter is `{ value, handle }`; value is the result of tipFormatter and handle is min or max.

tipFormatter.zh-CN: 设置提示的展示格式，每个手柄单独调用，参数为该手柄的值；默认显示当前取值，null 隐藏提示。
tipFormatter.en-US: Format of the tooltip, called once per handle with that handle's value. Shows the current value by default; null hides the tooltip.

tooltipOnMark.en-US: Whether the marks on the rail have a tooltip.

tooltipVisible.en-US: Whether the tooltip is always visible.

value.zh-CN: 当前取值，可用 `bind:value` 双向绑定。`bind:value={get, set}` 时完全受控；只传 `value` 时作为初值，父级再传新值时以父级为准；不传时由 Slider 自己管理，初值为 min。
value.en-US: Current value; bind it with `bind:value`. `bind:value={get, set}` makes it fully controlled; a plain `value` is the initial value and a new value from the parent wins again; without it the Slider manages the value itself, starting at min.

verticalReverse.zh-CN: 反转垂直方向，即上大下小。
verticalReverse.en-US: Reverses the vertical direction, so the larger value is on top.
